item.title: From skepticism to reflection on Safe Haven Box
item.description: Dear Editor: I want to thank Mr. McNeff for his response to my letter. I agree that it is unfortunate that any community would need a Safe Haven Box. That being said, I did do research before writing my original letter, and I stand by that. A quick Internet search and a scan of Census Bureau data shows the median family income in Washington County of $54,000. item.title: A call to let the prosecutor do his work
item.description: Dear Editor: I don’t write letters to the editor, but the time has come! To those people that are upset about our current prosecuting attorney, I wonder why you were not upset about our previous prosecutor! The taxpayers are still paying for the mess he left us in. True is still dealing with those issues and has cleaned up about half of them! I would encourage you to give him a chance to do his job for the full term. Then we will see how things are going. item.description: Weiser traveled to McCall on Wednesday, Feb. 4 to take on McCall and Tri-Valley. Weiser would defeat McCall 68-15 and Tri-Valley 68-22.
